Zone 3 of the sprinkler timer delivered almost no water for two weeks. After the hose investigation, this turned out to be the **same failure mode: a cracked brass fitting** (this time at the zone-3 manifold), not the timer program and not a clogged head.

**CORRECTION:** I initially reprogrammed the timer thinking the schedule was wrong — that was WRONG, the schedule was fine. The brass fitting was the issue, exactly as in [[garden-hose-leak]].

**How to apply:** brass fittings on this property are failing with age; treat any sudden pressure/flow loss as a fitting crack until proven otherwise.
